    "Reduce forecast overshoots following sharp upward moves in price (e.g., post-70+ peaks).",

    "Increase downward bias when sentiment is consistently low (e.g., <0.00) and price is trending down.",
    "Treat early in the 30-day window as more volatile — apply tighter range correction if sentiment is neutral or negative.",
    "If sentiment is positive (e.g., >0.33) and price is trending up, allow slight overestimation but cap at +10% above recent high.",
    "For long-term (e.g., 30-day) forecasts, reduce volatility by smoothing out extreme outliers in model output."
